observation: After package/source commit 35a0f18f8e9cf54a56cec0eded620397a98f992f, the first combined status-and-push wrapper let PowerShell misparse the unquoted HEAD^{tree} revision. Git rejected the resulting invalid revision before the push command ran.
mutation: local commit 35a0f18f8e9cf54a56cec0eded620397a98f992f already existed; no remote mutation occurred
correction: Quote the tree revision separately, retain this evidence in a successor commit, and push the exact branch without combining revision syntax into the mutation wrapper.
release_effect: The failed wrapper is excluded from positive evidence. Public package/source identity remains unverified until the successor commit is pushed and reconciled.
